journeys.title: Make the memory the gift
journeys.subtitle: Start with one shared moment, then personalize it.
journeys.whySelected: The export's clearest value signal: 11.8k plays, 1,246 likes and 514 saves. Every slide teaches a reusable personalization move instead of listing generic products.

products.name: Composable Italian charm bracelet

products.matchEvidence: Slide 5 preserves a handwritten note and small keepsakes in a memory box; the verified frame opens from the front for arranging those pieces.

journeys.title: Build a basket that isn't random
journeys.subtitle: One hobby + one upgrade + one comfort + one plan.
journeys.whySelected: The four-part formula is specific enough to use immediately and broad enough to personalize for any recipient.

journeys.title: Attention over price
journeys.subtitle: Repeat one color, create tiny reveals, handwrite the headline.
journeys.whySelected: It completes the journey after purchase with three concrete presentation rules and an achievable low-budget result.
